Select the first 200 distinct activity rows ordered by activity_id ascending. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno for molecule_chembl_id (use chembl_id, not molregno), join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid for target_chembl_id and target_name. Filter where target_dictionary.organism is 'Homo sapiens', target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units is 'nM', standard_type is one of EC50, IC50, or AC50, and standard_value is below 50. Return activity_id, molecule_chembl_id, target_chembl_id, target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units.
